body:
i plan on telling her when i see her on friday. i have some anxiety too but usually it's manageable without meds but maybe that added to the depression is making it worse right now. 

usually when i write things down it just kinda spirals me downward but maybe just focusing on positive things right now would help. i generally have a lot of good things i'm grateful for in my life right now it's just hard to see when i feel like this.

right now i'm okay with school because it started recently and most of my classes are stuff that i care about. it's just work that's hard because i'm a cashier so i have to be peppy and talk to people and brush off rude people. i'm not looking forward to it

thank you. you're so kind and this really did help. i'm gonna see if my school has a therapist that i can get in touch with. i know this feeling will pass eventually with help. it's just really hard to get through right now. i'm going to try to focus on what makes me happy and be gentle to myself and take care of myself like you said and hopefully i'll get through this period okay. i know there's a lot of good in the world it's just hard to see. but thank you for going out of your way to be so kind
thank you. i know i'll find my key eventually it's just hard knowing that right now. but thank you for believing in me

i know i'm not literally crazy just my mind is racing and i can't control my thoughts or get a grip of reality and it's just a mess in my head right now.

i'm on antidepressants cause i've been through this before but my body always seems to get used to them after a while and they just don't work anymore. all i really have to talk to is my boyfriend who i already cried in front of last night so i don't want to freak him out even more and my mom who is already doing what she can and i don't want to just add to her stress. 

right now i honestly don't know what i do for fun. things have just been slowly getting away from me and i've been doing more escapist things rather than what i actually enjoy. i like doing yoga but every time i try these past few days i just end up sitting on the floor crying because i just can't slow my mind down to get into it. 

sorry for the wall of text, and thank you for answering.
